homeMeta.title: Gîte Au fil de l'eau — Holiday rental in Storckensohn
homeMeta.description: Gîte Au fil de l'eau in Storckensohn, a renovated former farmhouse that can host up to 10 guests, with wellness area and terrace in the heart of the High Vosges of Alsace.

hero.title: Welcome to the Gîte
hero.intro1: The Gîte Au fil de l'eau offers a peaceful setting to relax in the heart of the High Vosges of Alsace, in the small village of Storckensohn.
hero.intro2: Located in a renovated former farmhouse turned into a comfortable country home, the gîte can accommodate up to 10 guests.

items.kitchen: A fully equipped kitchen opening onto the living room
items.dining: The dining room and the veranda with piano and wood burner
items.tvRoom: A second lounge with TV and DVD player set up in the former barn
items.bedroom: A bedroom with a 140/190 bed and an en-suite bathroom (walk-in shower, sink, toilet)

items.bedrooms: 3 bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom (shower or bath, sink, toilet) and beds 90/200 that can be combined into 180/200
items.mezzanine: A small mezzanine lounge in the former barn

wellness.text: A wellness area with spa, sauna, bathroom and loungers is accessible by lift on level -1. Its large bay windows open onto the orchard meadow along the stream.

accessibility.text: The ground floor and the wellness area on level -1 are accessible to persons with reduced mobility.
